question:
A coin is tossed 8 times. What is the probability that

(a) exactly 4 heads occur;

(b) at least 6 heads occur;

(c) what are the mean and variance of the number of heads observed?
explanation:
Each toss: Bernoulli(p=1/2); n=8
(a) $P(X=4)=C(8,4)\times(1/2)^4\times(1/2)^4=70\times1/256=35/128$
(b) $P(\text{at least 6 heads})=P(6)+P(7)+P(8)$
$=C(8,6)/256 + C(8,7)/256 + 1/256$
$=28/256+8/256+1/256=37/256$
(c) For binomial distribution:
Mean=$np=8\times1/2=4$
Variance=$npq=8\times1/2\times1/2=2$

Final answers:
(a)$35/128$

(b)$37/256$

(c)Mean:4, Variance:2
